title: Relation to accepted-HNF replay witnesses
objective: Retain and reconstruct exact bidirectional relation/HNF witnesses for the authentic 73-relation h=1 cubic

oracles: Independent exact matrix identities on the authentic 73-relation cubic

handoff.summary: Adds a source-transparent native leaf that authenticates retained hnfspec provenance A*V=[0|H], computes V inverse with the existing exact unimodular inverse, and publishes compact R2P=V[:,z:] and P2R=V^-1[z:,:]. The authentic 73-relation h=1 cubic passes CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged checks of A*R2P=H, H*P2R=A, and both inverse orders.
risks: The durable replay boundary is the active 8x15 hnfspec matrix before hnffinal deletes all eight unit pivots, not the raw 66x73 relation-record owner or the empty final h=1 quotient.
The checker requires an explicitly supplied qualified resident output artifact; fixture hash a705f625bf6f47a25b62dd3ff8485abf1c8af5ec0f12d15ee5cbb89cf6195e0b was used for the recorded pass.
The first recorded focused run failed because two concurrent full builds temporarily clobbered dist; a clean sequential pnpm build and the subsequent recorded focused run passed.

The repository-wide portable tier reached 191 passing files, then failed on the pre-existing modular q-expansion source freeze because integration's architecture/package-graph.json hash differs from that frozen baseline; this lane does not own either file.
next_steps: In the integration lane, call the leaf while hnf_matbnew, hnf_full_h, and hnf_hnf_transform still describe the same successful hnfspec boundary.
Publish the active 8x15 relation matrix and the two 120-entry compact witnesses into final replay; do not attempt to map raw 66x73 records directly to the empty h=1 quotient.
